mentions.name: tech-professor.com
mentions.description: A learning platform whose content is built directly from the source code in a user's pull requests and followed repositories, letting developers quiz themselves and their teams based on the code they ship. Currently in beta with free sign-up.
mentions.audience: Developers and their teams learning from the code they ship
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a side-project called tech-professor.com which is a platform for learning. The content is built directly from the source code in your pull request and repositories you follow. So you can quiz yourself and your team based on the code you ship.
